title: Catalog documents stop indexing after a feed rollout
summary: New catalog documents are being rejected by the indexing path, and product freshness is falling behind.
precursor: The supplier feed began publishing the market_region facet after a catalog schema release.
impact: Products updated in the current feed window remain absent from search until the index catches up.

title: Relevance scoring disrupts search responses
summary: Requests that include relevance scoring intermittently exceed their response budget and return incomplete result sets.
precursor: The recommendation team enabled an expanded feature set for the afternoon catalog ranking experiment.
impact: Search latency breaches the storefront objective during scored queries, reducing completed product searches.

title: Autocomplete becomes unavailable after traffic shift
summary: Autocomplete returns an availability error while full-text search remains responsive.
precursor: Suggestions traffic began moving to a replacement component during a cluster-pool rollout.
impact: Shoppers lose query suggestions and submit fewer refined searches, while direct search queries continue to work.

title: A slice of catalog updates stops reaching search
summary: Some catalog updates remain pending while other feed partitions continue to advance.
precursor: A supplier started sending nested availability windows in its catalog export.
impact: Affected products show outdated availability in search, and their pending updates do not clear with normal retries.

title: Facet counts disagree with the current catalog
summary: Facet panels continue displaying counts from an earlier catalog snapshot after product records have changed.
precursor: A bulk category correction and product reindex completed during the nightly catalog maintenance window.
impact: Customers are steered toward outdated category and availability refinements, hiding matching products from filtered searches.
